support_spans: Point-of-care (POC) urine human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) test: negative
Ultrasonography: Confirmed live intrauterine pregnancy at 24 weeks
concepts.why: The combination of a negative point-of-care urine hCG test and a high serum hCG level with confirmation of a live intrauterine pregnancy is unusual and points to a heterotopic pregnancy.

contradict_spans: Ultrasonography: Confirmed live intrauterine pregnancy at 24 weeks
concepts.why: The very high serum hCG level is unusual and could suggest a molar pregnancy, but the confirmation of a live intrauterine pregnancy makes this less likely.
The undetectable thyroid-stimulating hormone level is unusual and could suggest a thyroid storm, but the unremarkable vital signs make this less likely.
The history of thyroid condition and undetectable thyroid-stimulating hormone level are unusual and could suggest Graves' disease.

contradict_spans: Ultrasonography: Confirmed live intrauterine pregnancy at 24 weeks
concepts.why: The tender midline abdominal mass is unusual and could suggest an abdominal pregnancy, but the confirmation of a live intrauterine pregnancy makes this less likely.
The patient has a history of thyroid condition and was prescribed methimazole, indicating a possible diagnosis of hyperthyroidism.

support_spans: Point-of-care (POC) urine human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) test: negative
Ultrasonography: Confirmed live intrauterine pregnancy at 24 weeks
concepts.why: The patient presents with amenorrhea, a negative urine hCG test, and a subsequent high serum hCG level, confirmed by ultrasonography, indicating a pregnancy.
The patient has a tender midline abdominal mass, which could be indicative of an abdominal mass or tumor.
The patient presents with constipation, which could be a symptom of an underlying condition such as bowel obstruction.

support_spans: Ultrasonography: Confirmed live intrauterine pregnancy at 24 weeks
concepts.why: Heterotopic pregnancy is a process that unifies the findings of abdominal pain, constipation, and a tender midline abdominal mass with the presence of both a negative point-of-care urine hCG test and a high serum hCG level, as well as the ultrasonography confirmation of a live intrauterine pregnancy.
Graves' disease is a process that unifies the findings of a history of thyroid condition, undetectable thyroid-stimulating hormone, and the prescription of methimazole.

support_spans: Ultrasonography: Confirmed live intrauterine pregnancy at 24 weeks
concepts.why: Pregnancy-associated thyroid dysfunction is a process that unifies the findings of a history of thyroid condition, undetectable thyroid-stimulating hormone, and the confirmation of a live intrauterine pregnancy.

Methimazole-induced agranulocytosis is a process that unifies the findings of the prescription of methimazole and the symptoms of abdominal fullness and constipation, which may be related to neutropenia.
